name: materialize-intermediate-findings-workflow
description: Three-phase workflow variant of materialize-intermediate-findings. Phase 1: read first 3 logs, write error-analysis.md. Phase 2: read remaining 2 logs + deployments, update error-analysis.md and write timeline-correlation.md. Phase 3: read remaining data files, correlate everything, write root-cause-report.md. The three-phase split enforces materialization cadence by making each phase produce a write before it can continue to the next batch of reads.
